scenicChapters.title: Romantic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 25 km this is Romantic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-limessection-between-watchtowers-.story: From Wilburgstetten it runs 188 km to Wilburgstetten; allow about 3 h 14 of riding. On the way it passes Watchtowers WP 13/37 to 13/40, Watchtower WP 14/28, Watchtowers WP 14/63 to 14/78 including fo and back through Watchtower WP 14/28. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
